Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 timing.duration = 90 (the reveal lasts the 3 s the sheet gives); rank 0 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, crossing a filament); rank 0 statuses: revealed 90 ticks; rank 3 timing.duration = 108 (the reveal channel at rank 3 (3.6 s)); rank 3 defenses[0].percent = 10 (a 10% damage-taken bonus is the light end of exposed's 40%); rank 3 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, crossing a filament); rank 3 statuses: revealed 108 ticks; rank 5 timing.duration = 120 (the reveal channel at rank 5 (4 s)); rank 5 geometry.radius = 500 (a 5 m spread covers a squad; the module schema has no recipient on statuses, so the radius carries it); rank 5 statuses[0].when = "always" ("always" stands for the trigger the prose names, crossing a filament); rank 5 statuses: revealed 120 ticks.

mechanics.stock: An enemy that crosses one of Vellum's filaments, lines or burst circles is revealed through cover for 3 s (90 ticks), leaving a visible outline.
counterplay: Avoid crossing her lines and zones; the reveal lasts 3 s, so break line of sight and wait it out; the spread at transcendent rank needs a second enemy within 5 m.

forms.name: barbed filament
forms.description: Hits leave a trailing filament that slows the target by 20% for 2 s (60 ticks); the round deals 70 damage and 6 stability.

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock filament
a 20% slow is the nixie residue slow, a light basic rider

forms.name: tension snap
forms.description: Every third filament hit on the same target snaps the line: the target is rooted for 0.5 s (15 ticks) and takes 25 extra stability. Hits still slow by 20% for 2 s (60 ticks) and deal 79 damage.

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock filament
a snap carries 25 stability, below rook's crash pulse (45) and enough with the active's 5 per pulse to expose a slowed target
the module schema has no whenN on effects; the N of the "nth" condition (every third hit) is carried in whenValue
the sheet gives no snap effect; a 0.5 s root stands for the tension of a snapped line

forms.name: enclosing lattice
forms.description: Three 8 m (800 cm) lines close into a triangle. Everything inside or on its lines takes 45 damage and 5 stability every pulse and is slowed by 50%.

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock lattice
the three lines turn 120° at each corner to close an equilateral triangle
the sheet says only "encloses and slows"; 50% is the heavy end of the roster's slows (hex 50%, raven 55%)
three lines, as the sheet shows; the pulses apply to the enclosed area, not only the lines

The source sheet presents a breaker / field control concept and depicts filament rail rifle. These are source labels, not normalized gameplay contracts.

dossier.identity: field-control breaker who strings slowing filament lattices across the arena, folds space into interrupting bursts and marks everything that crosses her lines.
dossier.selectionRationale: the sheet labels her "breaker / field control". roles are striker, breaker, bastion and operator only, so she takes breaker, the nearest: slow lines, interrupting detonations and revealing traces break enemy formations and casts rather than heal or hold ground. line zones and chained delayed bursts separate her from rook's seizure zone, hex's contagion burst and tessa's lock fields.
dossier.weaponConcept: filament rail rifle (long-range rail rifle with a pink filament spool drum, servo tensioner, prism emitter and barrel shroud, plus a six-fin hardlight ribbon backpack that works as stabiliser and sensor array)

lore.backstory: former survey cartographer for the city grid authority who spent a decade mapping load paths through buildings that were already coming down. she kept the survey rifle, rewound its spool with hardlight filament and now draws the same lines in the air, because pressure has a shape and she knows where it breaks.
lore.syndicateRecord: redrew a fortified district's sightlines in a single afternoon and left the syndicate's garrison standing in the one place no cover reached.
lore.psychProfile: composed, exact and quietly amused; treats a battlefield as a drawing that has not been finished and her opponents as the corrections.
lore.combatQuote: “lines find what others miss. step over this one and i will know where you went.”

forms.description: Folds a point up to 10 m (1000 cm) away: after 0.8 s (24 ticks) it bursts in a 2 m (200 cm) radius for 200 damage and 30 stability. Cost 38 · windup 0.5 s (15 ticks) · cooldown 18 s (540 ticks).

forms.name: shear fold
forms.description: The detonation interrupts every enemy it hits, cancelling casts in progress; fuse 0.68 s, 260 damage and 30 stability.

forms.name: chain fold
forms.description: Three burst circles of 2 m (200 cm) detonate in a chain: the first deals 300 damage, then each following burst jumps to the nearest enemy within 4 m (400 cm) for 70% damage (210). Every burst deals 30 stability and interrupts; fuse 0.6 s (18 ticks).

iconFamily.subject: a bold folded lattice of filament lines around a single chunky fold node
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Vellum. Theme: filament lattice. Subject: a bold folded lattice of filament lines around a single chunky fold node. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
